OPEN HISTORICAL OBSERVATORY

Sleep raw data (RRI / accelerometer arrays) and exercise live-data streams are intentionally not flattened yet.

HEALTH CONNECT

Galaxy Watch data reaches this app through Samsung Health → Android Health Connect → the Android host. ENERGY reads only: sleep sessions and stages, heart rate, resting heart rate, exercise sessions, daily steps, distance and energy, oxygen saturation, VO₂ max, weight, body fat, lean body mass and basal metabolic rate. Nothing is ever written back. Sleep, heart rate and exercise feed the engine; the rest is stored as context only. Manual entries always take precedence over automatic values.

BROWSER

Automatic signals need the Android build.

This preview runs in a browser, where Health Connect is not reachable. Manual override stays available; the Galaxy Watch link activates inside the Android app.
